messages.subject: Spatio-temporal disease mapping
parts:
Hello,


I am trying to fit the following non-parametric spatio-temporal disease mapping model:

O_it|r_it ~ Poisson(E_it*r_it)

log(r_it) = alpha + u_i + v_i + gamma_t + phi_t + delta_it    for i=1,...,I and t=1,...,T


Using a completely structured TypeIV space-time interaction (Knorr-Held, 2000),
the structure matrix for the interaction (R_delta = R_u x R_gamma) has a rank deficiency of I+T-1 if gamma follows a RW1.

According to Schödle and Held (2011), "to ensure identifiability of interaction term delta, specific sum-to-zero constraints have to be used".


My data have I=501 areas and T=23 years, so I have to specify the following linear constraints

A*delta=e, where A is a 523 x 11523 matrix.


The problem is that when I run the model in INLA (even with the "gaussian" strategy), this error message appears:
"This application has requested the Runtime to terminate it in an unusual way."


The model is well fitted when I use a TypeI or TypeIII interaction, so I think that the problem is the high number of linear constraints.

Is there any way to solve this problem?


Thank you very much,
Aritz.
